what: plan checks revise exit code, but helper reports logical failures through REVISE_STATUS with exit 0
scenario_or_breakage: All revise tiers can fail, plan.txt is restored, helper exits 0, and the loop treats the round as successfully auto-applied
suggested_fix: Parse REVISE_STATUS from stdout and require ok; treat failed-no-patch, failed-validation, and failed-apply as LOOP_STATUS=revision-failed

what: Revise artifact layout conflicts with the proposed publisher allowlist
scenario_or_breakage: The helper writes plan-review/round-N/revise/*, while the plan says design-log-publish should disallow revise/ under plan-review; any auto-revise round will fail publish
suggested_fix: Choose one layout and update both sides: either move revise output to DESIGN_TMPDIR/revise/round-N or explicitly allow a constrained round-N/revise allowlist

what: Accepted OOS items from earlier internal rounds are overwritten
scenario_or_breakage: The tally truncates oos-accepted-design.md every round, and file-design-oos only reads that final top-level file; round-1 accepted OOS can disappear after round 2
suggested_fix: Add an accumulated accepted-OOS artifact across internal rounds and make Step 5b read it, with stable IDs or round-qualified IDs

what: Moving auto-apply into the loop bypasses Gate B's shared post-apply pipeline
scenario_or_breakage: The helper runs ACTION=EMIT_PLAN, but passive Gate B no longer runs duplicate sweep, full validator dispatch, or Step 2b.5 size/split gate after the final revised plan
suggested_fix: Factor the post-revision pipeline into a scriptable helper and call it after successful auto-revise, at least before Step 3b on the final loop result

what: Single-pass compatibility contract is internally inconsistent
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says omitted --round-cap preserves single-pass and LOOP_STATUS=complete, but the pseudocode still auto-applies and exits converged or cap-hit
suggested_fix: Track whether --round-cap was explicitly supplied; define legacy single-pass behavior separately, including whether revise runs and when complete is emitted

what: New integration harness is not listed as a Makefile update target
scenario_or_breakage: The plan creates scripts/test-design-multi-round-integration.sh and says make lint runs it, but the file list omits Makefile changes needed for .PHONY, target, and shard wiring
suggested_fix: Add ### UPDATED: Makefile to the plan and specify the target plus test-harness shard wiring
